description: This file defines the 'Remote' class which encapsulates AJAX request handling for fetching data asynchronously for typeahead/autocomplete functionality. It includes constructor setup, settings configuration, data fetching, and request cancellation methods.

classes.name: Remote
classes.description: A class responsible for managing remote data fetching with customizable options and request management.

methods.name: Remote()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Remote object with configuration options such as URL, prepare, transform functions, and transport settings.

methods.name: settings()
methods.description: Returns default AJAX settings for the request, including URL, request type, and data type.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an AJAX GET request with the query, processes the response with the transform function, and executes the callback.

methods.name: cancelLastRequest
methods.description: Cancels the last ongoing request via the transport mechanism.
